execution: Actual HTTP on loopback, real PostgreSQL, non-owner non-bypass runtime role, fixture identity verifier

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

dataset.readCommandMix: 40 accepted-summary reads and ten canonical pause/resume mutations per cohort

timing.latencyDefinition: Client-observed loopback HTTP through response JSON, including local transit and fixture verification; not pure server instrumentation.

limits: Local shared execution host; no production deployment, remote network or capacity/SLA proof.
Explicit in-memory fixture session verifier measured separately; no OIDC login, JWT signature/JWKS or provider performance claim.
Warmup precedes measured cohorts; nearest-rank p95 is reported for 800 reads and 200 commands.
Clock evidence is review-required session evidence. No native clock continuity, device durability, background behavior or phone responsiveness claim.
QL03 requires supported lower-end Android hardware; QL02, QL07 and QL11 remain physical-device gates.
QL09 offsite recovery objectives and QL10 monthly availability require operating evidence, not this bounded rehearsal.
